channel.title: BK Reader (The Brooklyn Reader) - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from BK Reader (The Brooklyn Reader) (bkreader.com)

item.title: As a Neurologist, This Is What I Wish Everyone Knew About Exercise And The Brain
item.description: Op-Ed: What I tell my patients—and what I try to practice myself—is this: you don’t need perfection. You just need to move.

item.title: Brooklyn Residents React With Discontent Over U.S. Attack on Iran
item.description: Many Brooklyn residents said they were not surprised by the U.S.- Israeli attack on Iran, but some felt anxiety over possible retaliation on U.S. soil, while others were critical of Washington’s focus on foreign policy when U.S. citizens were facing an affordability crisis.

item.title: NYC Cuts Public Recreation Funding to Historic Lows
item.description: NYC has sharply cut recreation funding, leaving communities with fewer facilities, staff and programs, according to a new report.

item.title: Free Tree Giveaways Coming to Brooklyn for Earth Month
item.description: Residents can pick up native trees at events in Sunset Park, Canarsie, Bensonhurst and more from April through May.

item.title: Brooklyn Public Library Ends Passport Services After Federal Order
item.description: Brooklyn residents must now turn to post offices and the county clerk after the Brooklyn Public Library was forced to shut down its passport program, the Brooklyn Paper reported.

item.title: Borough President Funds Baby Showers in High-Need Brooklyn Neighborhoods
item.description: Seven Brooklyn nonprofits receive up to $5,000 each through Borough President Antonio Reynoso’s Community Baby Shower Fund to support new and expecting parents.

item.title: Con Ed Urges Brooklyn Residents to File For Reimbursements After Snow
item.description: Claims can be submitted within 30 days of the outage if you lost power for more than two days.

item.title: South Brooklyn Health Opens Expanded $2M Oncology And Infusion Center
item.description: New York City Health + Hospitals/South Brooklyn Health unveiled a $2 million expansion of its Oncology and Infusion Center, nearly doubling capacity and adding new cancer support services.

item.title: New York Prisoners Are Aging
item.description: A new report from State Comptroller Thomas P. DiNapoli examines post-COVID shifts in New York’s prison population, highlighting the growing share of incarcerated people age 50 and older.

item.title: Brooklyn Children’s Museum Appoints Tanya Layne to Board of Trustees
item.description: Brooklyn Children’s Museum names Brooklyn resident and art industry legal executive Tanya Layne to its Board of Trustees.
